title: ExxonMobil Announces 2025 Results
author: Sigma Capital
metaDescription: ExxonMobil announced fourth-quarter 2025 earnings of $6.5 billion and full-year earnings of $28.8 billion. The company distributed $37.2 billion to shareholders
excerpt: ExxonMobil announced fourth-quarter 2025 earnings of $6.5 billion and full-year earnings of $28.8 billion. The company distributed $37.2 billion to shareholders in 2025.

content.introduction: ExxonMobil announced fourth-quarter 2025 earnings of $6.5 billion and full-year earnings of $28.8 billion. The company distributed $37.2 billion to shareholders in 2025.
body: SPRING, Texas – January 30, 2026– Exxon Mobil Corporation today announced fourth-quarter 2025 earnings of $6.5 billion, or $1.53 per share. Earnings excluding identified items were $7.3 billion, or $1.71 per share. Cash flow from operating activities was $12.7 billion and free cash flow was $5.6 billion. Shareholder distributions totaled $9.5 billion, including $4.4 billion of dividends and $5.1 billion of share repurchases. For the full-year 2025, the company reported earnings of $28.8 billion and distributed $37.2 billion to shareholders, including $17.2 billion of dividends and $20.0 billion of share repurchases, consistent with previously announced plans. * Generated industry-leading earnings of $28.8 billion and cash flow from operations of $52.0 billion1. *1* *Earnings, earnings per share, earnings excluding identified items per share, earnings per share excluding identified items CAGR, and cash flow from operations compare IOCs' reported results or FactSet consensus as of January 28, 2026.
